description: Fires most reliably on the first move of the game, when the opponent opens in centre column 3 (strongest) or edge column 0 or 6. It does not fire for openings in 1, 2, 4 or 5. The other half of its firing is spread thinly over later positions with no clean rule, such as early opponent stacking in column 6 (6,6,6 is its maximum) and late moves that fill column 6, 1, 4 or 0.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to its maximum changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 5 positions.
notes: Layer 1. Best dev F1 0.644 (P 1.00, R 0.475) for the ply-1 rule; sim share 0.00. Rules added for early column-6 stacking or late column-filling moves had only about 12% precision and lowered F1 (0.49-0.50). A broad hot-cell lookup scored F1 0.19. In minimal pairs the activation depends on the whole board in no clear pattern, and no last-move cell fires more than 20% of the time. Steering has no effect, so this may be a random direction. Synthesis could not beat the dev max (6,6,6 equals it).
